analysis_scope: completed exported static evidence only; no product execution

real_capacity_correctness_guard.scope: Original real 10,000-file functional correctness guard under race; not a formal scan timing or capacity sample.

count_diagnostics.scope: One traced diagnostic sample per source/profile/phase. Work counts only; no timing, allocation, pool-wait or child-CPU comparison is derived from these samples. Raw marker values remain retained in the matrix.
count_diagnostics.transaction_scope: Classified AUTH committed transactions equal explicit attributed AUTH COMMIT plus implicit AUTH commits recognized by the unchanged v2 classifier, including zero-row implicit commits. They are a classified subset, not total operation-startup authorization transactions: new startup SQL may be unrecognized. Raw SQL/BEGIN/COMMIT remain valid client-command counts. A classified zero does not prove zero startup checks or authorization transactions. Error/unconfirmed attempts and explicit rollbacks remain separate. Single-row responses are not proof of final Go authorization grants. Source and selected correctness evidence establish the startup-only policy independently.
